_note: The home page's footage. Every value under a "media" key is a clip id in src/data/media.json (see MEDIA-IDS.md); npm run check:media lists any that are missing. The reel is a 12 s loop (its end joins its start without a jump) with a 4:5 phone copy built in (its "mobile" entry), so pages just use <Video id="home-reel" />. The showreel is 35 s, title-free and not a loop: load it only when someone opens the reel player (it is not counted in the 8 MB home budget). The glances are 1:1 loops for the "at a glance" strip, each from the case named next to it. Each case's docket clip comes from its case file (clips.docket).
